AUTOMATIC.description: The controller is configured to automatically execute a program.

EDIT.description: The controller is currently functioning as a programming device and is           not capable of executing an active program.

MANUAL.description: Operations based on the instructions received from an external source.

MANUAL_DATA_INPUT.description: The operator can enter a series of operations for the controller to perform.

SEMI_AUTOMATIC.description: The controller executes a single set of instructions from an active           program and then stops until given a command to execute the next set           of instructions.
